First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 4:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @queers_in_gear the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Queers in Gear Saturday Ride group ride

A queer cycling group based in Portland and Lewiston-Auburn, Maine. The Portland ride meets at the Gear Hub, a nonprofit community bike shop, for a 10 to 12 mile social loop. No-drop, all levels, lights required.
